about: Fixed questions and answer sentences for "Ask about this company" (D95). FootnoteKit's QuestionIntent and AnswerSentence hold the same keys and text in this order; FootnoteKit's ContractTests fail when they drift. backend/tests/test_company_questions_contract.py runs the neutrality guard over every sentence. Sentences hold no digits: the app renders figures from exact decimals. Questions are the reader's own words, so only the digit and language rules apply to them.

intents.en: Does it make or lose money?

sentences.ko: 이 앱은 주식을 사라거나 팔라고 권하지 않아요.
sentences.en: This app doesn't tell you to buy or sell shares.

sentences.ko: 대신 회사가 공시에서 밝힌 사업과 실적을 보여 드려요. 판단은 직접 해 주세요.
sentences.en: Instead, it shows the business and results the company reported in its filings. The decision is yours.

sentences.ko: 이 앱은 이미 끝난 기간의 실적만 보여 줘요. 앞으로의 매출은 추정하지 않아요.
sentences.en: This app shows results for periods that have ended. It doesn't estimate future revenue.

sentences.ko: 회사가 직접 낸 전망 공시가 있어요. 확정된 실적이 아니라 회사가 스스로 밝힌 내용이에요.
sentences.en: The company filed its own outlook. It is what the company said about the future, not a reported result.

sentences.ko: 이 회사가 낸 전망 공시는 앱에 없어요.
sentences.en: The app has no outlook filing from this company.

sentences.ko: 회사가 밝힌 사업 설명이 아직 앱에 없어요.
sentences.en: The app doesn't have the company's own description of its business yet.

sentences.ko: 이 회사의 분기 보고서가 앱에 없어요.
sentences.en: The app has no quarterly report from this company.

sentences.ko: 이 회사의 연간 실적이 앱에 없어요.
sentences.en: The app has no annual figures from this company.

sentences.ko: 각 기간을 작년 같은 기간과 비교했어요. 더 긴 기간의 흐름은 다루지 않아요.
sentences.en: Each period is compared with the same period a year earlier. The app doesn't cover a longer trend.

sentences.ko: 회사는 최근 분기 매출이 작년 같은 분기보다 늘었다고 보고했어요.
sentences.en: The company reported higher revenue for its latest quarter than for the same quarter a year earlier.

sentences.ko: 회사는 최근 분기 매출이 작년 같은 분기보다 줄었다고 보고했어요.
sentences.en: The company reported lower revenue for its latest quarter than for the same quarter a year earlier.

sentences.ko: 회사는 최근 분기 매출이 작년 같은 분기와 비슷했다고 보고했어요.
sentences.en: The company reported about the same revenue for its latest quarter as for the same quarter a year earlier.

sentences.ko: 최근 분기 매출은 작년 같은 분기와 비교할 수 없어요.
sentences.en: The latest quarter's revenue can't be compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

sentences.ko: 앱에 있는 최근 분기 보고서에는 매출이 없어요.
sentences.en: The latest quarterly report in the app doesn't state revenue.

sentences.ko: 회사는 최근 회계연도 매출이 그 전 해보다 늘었다고 보고했어요.
sentences.en: The company reported higher revenue for its latest fiscal year than for the year before.

sentences.en: The company reported a net profit for its latest quarter.

sentences.en: The company reported a net loss for its latest quarter.
